test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_merge_burst{burst}_vertical{vertical} (id UInt64, j JSON) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 10000, index_granularity = 1024, merge_max_block_size = 1024, enable_vertical_merge_algorithm = {vertical}, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_columns_to_activate = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE json_squash_src_burst{burst} (id UInt64, j JSON) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE json_squash_dst (id UInt64, j JSON) ENGINE = Null

CREATE TABLE otel_spans ( Timestamp DateTime64(9), TraceId String, SpanId String, ServiceName LowCardinality(String), SpanName LowCardinality(String), Duration UInt64, ResourceAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String), SpanAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String), `Events.Timestamp` Array(DateTime64(9)), `Events.Name` Array(LowCardinality(String)), `Events.Attributes` Array(Map(LowCardinality(String), String)), `Links.TraceId` Array(String), `Links.Attributes` Array(Map(LowCardinality(String), String)) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (ServiceName, SpanName, toDateTime(Timestamp)) SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 10000, enable_vertical_merge_algorithm = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE otel_spans_squash_src AS otel_spans ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE otel_spans_squash_dst AS otel_spans ENGINE = Null
test.fill_query: SELECT throwIf(groupArray(name) != arrayMap(i -> concat('all_', toString(i), '_', toString(i), '_0'), range(1, 65)) OR sum(rows) != 131072 OR countIf(part_type != 'Compact') != 0) FROM (SELECT name, rows, part_type FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'json_merge_burst{burst}_vertical{vertical}' AND active ORDER BY min_block_number)
SELECT throwIf(count() != 65536 OR max(blockSize()) != 128 OR min(blockSize()) != 128) FROM json_squash_src_burst{burst} SETTINGS max_threads = 1

INSERT INTO otel_spans_squash_src SELECT toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 9) + toIntervalMillisecond(number), hex(cityHash64(intDiv(number, 8))), hex(cityHash64(number)), concat('service_', toString(number % 16)), concat('op_', toString(number % 64)), cityHash64(number) % 1000000, map('service.name', concat('service_', toString(number % 16)), 'host.name', concat('host-', toString(number % 32)), 'k8s.pod.name', concat('pod-', toString(number % 256))), mapFromArrays(arrayMap(i -> concat('attr.', toString((number + i) % 64)), range(number % 12)), arrayMap(i -> toString(number * i), range(number % 12))), arrayMap(i -> toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 9) + toIntervalMillisecond(number + i), range(number % 3)), arrayMap(i -> concat('event_', toString(i)), range(number % 3)), arrayMap(i -> map('exception.type', concat('E', toString((number + i) % 10)), 'exception.message', concat('message ', toString(number))), range(number % 3)), arrayMap(i -> hex(cityHash64(number + i)), range(number % 2)), arrayMap(i -> map('link.kind', toString(i)), range(number % 2)) FROM numbers(131072) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 128, max_insert_block_size = 128, min_insert_block_size_rows = 128, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 131072 OR max(blockSize()) != 128 OR min(blockSize()) != 128) FROM otel_spans_squash_src SETTINGS max_threads = 1

INSERT INTO otel_spans SELECT * FROM otel_spans_squash_src SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 2048, max_insert_block_size = 2048, min_insert_block_size_rows = 2048, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

SELECT throwIf(groupArray(name) != arrayMap(i -> concat('all_', toString(i), '_', toString(i), '_0'), range(1, 65)) OR sum(rows) != 131072 OR countIf(part_type != 'Compact') != 0) FROM (SELECT name, rows, part_type FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'otel_spans' AND active ORDER BY min_block_number)
test.query: INSERT INTO json_squash_dst SELECT * FROM json_squash_src_burst{burst} SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 65536, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
INSERT INTO otel_spans_squash_dst SELECT * FROM otel_spans_squash_src SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 65536, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS json_squash_src_burst{burst} SYNC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS json_squash_dst SYNC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS otel_spans SYNC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS otel_spans_squash_src SYNC
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS otel_spans_squash_dst SYNC
